Title: Successful login with valid active user
Preconditions: Registered active user exists and dashboard is available
Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter registered email; 3. Enter correct password; 4. Click Log In
Expected Result: User is redirected to dashboard.

Title: Successful login establishes session
Steps: 1. Log in using valid credentials; 2. Inspect authenticated state or session cookie/token
Expected Result: Authenticated session is created and user can access dashboard resources.

Title: Wrong password shows generic error
Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter registered email; 3. Enter wrong password; 4. Click Log In
Expected Result: Error "Invalid email or password" is shown and user remains on login page.

Title: Unregistered email shows generic error
Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter unregistered email; 3. Enter any valid-format password; 4. Click Log In
Expected Result: Same generic error "Invalid email or password" is shown with no account-existence indication.

Title: Blank email prevents login request
Steps: 1. Leave Email blank; 2. Enter password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Required-field validation is shown for Email and no login request is sent.

Title: Blank password prevents login request
Steps: 1. Enter valid email; 2. Leave Password blank; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Required-field validation is shown for Password and no login request is sent.

Title: Both email and password blank
Steps: 1. Leave Email blank; 2. Leave Password blank; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Required-field validation is shown for both fields and no login request is sent.

Title: Invalid email without at-sign is rejected
Steps: 1. Enter malformed email; 2. Enter password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Inline message "Enter a valid email address" is shown.

Title: Invalid email without domain is rejected
Steps: 1. Enter malformed email; 2. Enter password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Inline message "Enter a valid email address" is shown.

Title: Invalid email with spaces is rejected
Steps: 1. Enter email containing internal spaces; 2. Enter password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Inline message "Enter a valid email address" is shown.

Title: Four failed attempts do not lock account
Preconditions: Registered active user exists; failed-attempt counter is zero
Steps: 1. Attempt login four times with wrong password within 15 minutes; 2. Attempt fifth login with correct password
Test Data: email=user@example.com; wrong password x4; then ValidPass123
Expected Result: User is not locked after four failures and valid login succeeds.

Title: Fifth failed attempt locks account
Preconditions: Registered active user exists; failed-attempt counter is zero
Steps: 1. Attempt login five times with wrong password within 15 minutes
Expected Result: Account is locked and message "Your account is locked. Try again later." is shown.

Title: Correct credentials during lockout remain blocked
Preconditions: Account is locked due to five failed attempts
Steps: 1. Enter correct email and correct password; 2. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login is denied and locked message is shown.

Title: Failed attempts outside 15-minute window do not lock account
Preconditions: Registered active user exists; failed-attempt counter is zero
Steps: 1. Make four failed attempts; 2. Wait more than 15 minutes; 3. Make one failed attempt
Test Data: wrong password attempts spread beyond 15 minutes
Expected Result: Account is not locked because failures are not five consecutive attempts within 15 minutes.

Title: Login allowed after 30-minute lockout expires
Steps: 1. Wait at least 30 minutes after lockout; 2. Enter correct credentials; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: User can log in successfully after lockout period ends.

Title: Email matching is case-insensitive
Preconditions: Registered active user exists with lowercase email
Steps: 1. Enter email with different case; 2. Enter correct password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login succeeds and user is redirected to dashboard.

Title: Password matching is case-sensitive
Steps: 1. Enter correct email; 2. Enter password with changed letter case; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login fails with "Invalid email or password".

Title: Refresh keeps authenticated user logged in
Steps: 1. Navigate to dashboard; 2. Refresh browser
Expected Result: User remains logged in and dashboard reloads successfully.

Title: Session expires after 24 hours
Steps: 1. Keep session idle or simulate time until 24 hours expires; 2. Refresh dashboard or access protected resource
Expected Result: Session is expired and user must log in again.

Title: Logout ends session before expiry
Steps: 1. Click Log Out; 2. Try to access dashboard; 3. Refresh browser
Expected Result: User is logged out and dashboard access redirects to login page.

Title: Inactive account cannot log in
Steps: 1. Enter inactive account email; 2. Enter correct password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Message "This account is inactive. Contact support." is shown and no session is created.

Title: Blank email shows required message instead of format message
Steps: 1. Leave Email blank; 2. Enter password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Required-field validation is shown, not email-format validation.

Title: Lockout message takes precedence after threshold
Steps: 1. Attempt an additional login with wrong password after lockout
Expected Result: Message "Your account is locked. Try again later." is shown instead of generic password error.

Title: Minimum length valid password authenticates when correct
Steps: 1. Enter registered email; 2. Enter correct 8-character password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login succeeds if password is correct and account is active.

Title: Maximum length valid password authenticates when correct
Steps: 1. Enter registered email; 2. Enter correct 64-character password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login succeeds if password is correct and account is active.

Title: Unregistered email with mixed case still returns generic error
Preconditions: Email does not exist in any case variation
Steps: 1. Enter mixed-case unregistered email; 2. Enter any password; 3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Generic error "Invalid email or password" is shown.

Title: Dashboard directly accessible after login
Steps: 1. After login, navigate directly to dashboard URL
Expected Result: Dashboard is accessible without re-entering credentials.

Title: Inactive account does not enter lockout flow
Steps: 1. Attempt login for inactive account multiple times with correct password
Expected Result: Inactive-account message is shown, user is not logged in, and behavior does not reveal lockout-specific state.
